title: REQ · Tick opens due SCHEDULED rounds and closes expired OPEN rounds using the injected clock
summary: Tick compares Clock.Now() with StartsAt and EndsAt and calls Open or Close
description: Context: Scheduler.Tick in backend/internal/round/scheduler.go uses a switch on rd.Status with !now.Before(rd.StartsAt) for SCHEDULED and !now.Before(rd.EndsAt) for OPEN. Desired behavior: due rounds open and expired rounds close exactly at the boundary. Expected result: one Open or Close call per due round. Why: automatic round lifecycle.
acceptance_criteria: Given a SCHEDULED round with StartsAt earlier than the clock, when Tick runs, then Open is called with the world and round IDs.
Given an OPEN round with EndsAt earlier than the clock, when Tick runs, then Close is called with the world and round IDs.
Given the clock equals StartsAt or EndsAt exactly, when Tick runs, then the round is acted on.

in_scope: Open and Close dispatch in Tick

technical_constraints: Use Scheduler.clock() so a nil Clock falls back to systemClock
definition_of_done: Open and Close dispatch matches the acceptance criteria
